description: This file defines the 'JTableChooser' class, a Swing-based user interface component for selecting a 'Table' object from a hierarchical display of ROM images and their associated tables. It provides a GUI dialog that displays ROM image data with categories, allowing users to choose a specific table for comparison or other operations.

classes.name: JTableChooser
classes.description: A Swing dialog component for selecting tables from ROM images, displaying a hierarchical tree of images and tables.

methods.name: showChooser
methods.description: Displays the GUI dialog for choosing a 'Table' from the ROM images, returning the selected 'Table' or null if canceled.

methods.name: mouseReleased
methods.description: Handles mouse release events to adjust the display tree size dynamically.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse click events.

methods.description: Empty implementation for mouse enter events.
